_about: Shared design tokens for all five apps. Per-app colours and radii are in design/<app_id>/tokens.json. Designed in Figma (link in design/README.md).

type.note: Sizes are logical pixels at 1.0 text scale. Text follows the phone size setting and a large-text option; layouts must not break at 150 percent.

motion.reduce_motion: when on: no shaking, no flashing, transitions at most fast_ms, no parallax

rules: No human figures, faces or silhouettes in any art (owner, 2026-11-10).
All art is original; no stock or AI-generated images.
Wording never pressures children; no prices on children’s cards (prices only behind the parent gate).

mastery.note: Suggested; the rule is set in issue 02 and may change.
